factual_methodology.summary: IMF 13 October 2026 primary WEO and GFSR releases cross-checked with July WEO and scheduled statistical calendars; forecasts, calendar events and realised observations kept distinct.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: English and Brazilian Portuguese analytical structure checked; no conversational framing or internal product roadmap; source references placed after body.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Three auditable tables, two matched numerical charts, two causal lines and one qualitative geographic exposure map per locale; numeric series and units verified.

research_depth.summary: Energy-trade transmission, technology investment versus productivity, sovereign duration and nonbank liquidity mismatches, distributional mechanisms and scenario falsifiers.

evidence_traceability.summary: Nine distinct first-party URLs across six institutional hosts per language; October WEO/GFSR IMF, July IMF, BLS release schedule, Eurostat, IBGE and IMF release calendar.

counterfactual_review.summary: Explicit conditional paths for AI productivity, AI valuation disappointment, persistent energy shock and financial stress, with discriminating indicators.

contrary_evidence: A higher world growth forecast can reflect forecast assumptions and investment spending rather than observed productivity.
Energy exporters and technology importers may show mixed outcomes; broad regional labels alone cannot identify winners and losers.
Higher long-term sovereign yields can result from expectations and term premia without demonstrating a fiscal solvency event.
IMF stress tests show aggregate banking resilience while identifying a weaker-institution tail.
limitations: Annual growth and inflation forecasts are not actual full-year observations.
Risk channels in the IMF GFSR are scenarios, not evidence of a realised shock on publication day.
No country-specific 2026 WEO forecasts were inferred from general IMF media commentary.
Editorial checking was conducted within this workflow; no claim of independent external peer review.
No 13 October closing prices or intraday market metrics were asserted.
notes: Bilingual QA on reviewed Git blobs, linked source verification and exact numeric visual parity; no external independent review claim. Build and live-site checks remain separate operational gates.
